name: alertflare
description: Low-noise digest of interesting activity across a Cloudflare account

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Read-only Cloudflare API token. Create it first with the permissions listed in the README (§2.1). **No Edit or Write permissions.**

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID (optional: leave empty and alertflare looks it up, at one extra API call per run).

POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN.description: Postmark **Server API token**, used when `NOTIFIER` is `postmark`. If you send with Cloudflare Email instead, enter `unused`.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender address. Postmark: a confirmed sender signature or domain. Cloudflare Email: an address on your Email Routing domain.

EMAIL_TO.description: Recipient address(es), comma separated. Cloudflare Email: each must be a verified Email Routing destination address.

DRY_RUN.description: `true` only logs digests (good for a first run); `false` sends email.

TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone for dates in messages and the heartbeat day, e.g. `Europe/London`.

ALERTFLARE_STATE.description: KV namespace for alertflare's state (already-reported findings, snapshots, heartbeat stats). A new one is created for you.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email binding, only used when `NOTIFIER` is `cloudflare`.
